Is this due to interaction effects, or just a convenient phrase that doesn't contain as much truth as one may hope. https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/tx-fuzz/blob/master/main.go Feels just like professors including easter eggs and free marks in (encouraged/required) readings. funds not SAFU marius recovery fork https://goerli.etherscan.io/tx/0x22e0b6356b1c6a16cb9ed2e21f83758b954e9821d5d1a1c394726e398840ef3b https://twitter.com/vdWijden/status/1499773017299333121 oh damn . just noticed the to address 0x000000009087a732b2299648212952b4fb92af71 it's weird yes, 32 hex chars, 16 bytes Bots very often do that to save gas. (zeros in calldata are cheaper) I figured an address with that many leading zeros would have had some activity on mainnet I saved my POAPs https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/374 <- list of tests we need to upstream (we don't run _all_ tests yet.) https://goerli.vanity.farm Your mic is still coming/going <@!415548822983278593>. Audible, but requires some effort. Aha, I found it: `0xdead...c0de` (https://opensea.io/assets/0xe3125964f8869f8ce5b0e56c2205a5f96bc7b124/1271264798157860491318541928806133826890501505246) why is ansgar so quiet I need to hop, see you guys! c ya heading out! cya 😄 same cya Mining rubbery toast, yes. Can we make "Alice wants their microwave to mine toast" an idiom for "Alice does not represent a significant portion of users"? 🤣 I need to head off. See you later. <@!420951281910284289> Did you know you are joined and muted/deafened this whole time? lol oops forgot to drop fully BRB, can hear but not speak. Does Keypass have a browser plugin? Not by the original developers, no. There are several I just use the autotype feature What is this? Press a global keyboard shortcut, it reads the name of the current window, and types a sequence of commands, like: `{USERNAME}{TAB}{PASSWORD}` I feel like that would result in frequently mistyping your password into the wrong field. Each entry has its own pattern. It happens occasionally if the form changes without me noticing. If I were to guess for you, your biggest objection might be that it's C# I used to write C# for a living, it used to be my favorite language (no longer is). Did you run it on osx or linux? 😛 No. Windows 4 Life. Yeeeahhh haha :gangster: How about android or iOS? Cause it ain't great C# on Android you mean? It is baller. Anyone who tells you different is lying. 😬 I've tried Xamarin back in the day And it was amazing, right? Sun is coming up, I think I'm out all.
